bundle.shortDescription: Offline-first Microsoft 365 and Gmail mail & calendar
bundle.longDescription: Graphite Mail is a free, open-source mail and calendar client for Microsoft 365 and Gmail, for Linux and Windows. Read, search, reply and plan offline; changes sync when you reconnect. You choose where your mail is stored.
